items.name: Take-Two
items.headline: Reiterates $8.0-$8.2B fiscal 2027 Net Bookings outlook as Grand Theft Auto VI launch nears
items.catalyst: Fiscal Q2 release (Nov. 9): net revenue $1.50B vs $1.77B; Net Bookings down 18% to $1.60B.
items.thesis: The release lists Grand Theft Auto VI for Nov. 19, 2026 and guides fiscal Q3 Net Bookings to $3.35B-$3.50B.

items.name: Occidental Petroleum
items.headline: Q3 EPS rises and principal debt falls to $10.0B
items.thesis: The company said it reduced principal debt by $1.8 billion to $10.0 billion and generated $4.1 billion of operating cash flow from continuing operations.

items.name: Lucid Group
items.headline: Q3 revenue up 4% as free cash flow consumption falls 30% sequentially
items.thesis: Free cash flow consumption was $1.04 billion and total liquidity $2.0 billion ($3.75 billion pro forma for a $1.75 billion DDTL increase with PIF).

items.name: Costco
items.headline: Declares $30 special cash dividend and reauthorizes $4B buyback
items.catalyst: Special dividend of $30 per share, about $13.3B in total, payable Dec. 4 to holders of record Nov. 24.
items.thesis: The board also reauthorized a repurchase program of up to $4 billion expiring in November 2030, replacing the 2023 program under which $3.1 billion had been purchased.

items.name: Steel Dynamics
items.headline: Adds $3.0B share repurchase authorization
items.catalyst: Additional $3.0B buyback, effective immediately; quarterly dividend of $0.53 per share.
items.thesis: The new program is additive to the prior $1.5 billion program, which had $216 million remaining on Sept. 30, 2026. The company says it has repurchased $8.2 billion of stock since 2017.

items.name: Elevance Health
items.headline: Reaffirms 2026 earnings guidance ahead of investor meetings
items.catalyst: Full-year 2026 shareholders' earnings guided to at least $22.00 per diluted share; adjusted at least $29.00.
items.thesis: The 8-K says the $22.00 figure includes approximately $7.00 per diluted share of net unfavorable items. Benefit expense ratio guidance is 90.2% plus or minus 50 basis points.

items.name: Invesco
items.headline: Reports October assets under management of $2,453.5B
items.catalyst: Preliminary AUM $2,453.5B, down 3.3% from the prior month-end; net long-term outflows $1.0B; money market net outflows $32.9B.
items.thesis: Unfavorable market returns decreased AUM by $51 billion. ETFs and index strategies stood at $771.0 billion and QQQ at $463.8 billion.

items.name: AST SpaceMobile
items.headline: Forms Rakuten AST joint venture for Japan satellite network
items.catalyst: Venture expected to receive up to 148 billion yen (approx. $1 billion) over about three years under Japan's J-LEO project.
items.thesis: Rakuten AST was agreed on Nov. 6 (Japan time) to build a direct-to-device LEO network; AST SpaceMobile will supply satellites and domestic operations are targeted by the end of March 2029.
